def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    occurrences = [120, 80, 50, 40, 30]
    top_two_occurrences = sum(sorted(occurrences, reverse=True)[:2])
    total_occurrences = sum(occurrences)
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    answer = (top_two_occurrences / total_occurrences) * 100
    
    # return answer
    return round(answer, 2)
